# WE CARE TO MAKE THE WORLD A HEALTHIER AND SAFER PLACE

## A worldwide provider of X-ray imaging systems for medical, non-destructive testing and precision
## contract coating services for a wide range of industrial, medical and electronic applications.



[ Medical Imaging ][61] [ Non-Destructive Testing ][62] [ Contract Manufacturing ][63]

## Innovation. Quality. Trust.

**Carestream is a vibrant global company with a proven history of superb imaging technology and
unparalleled service.**

That history is now poised to continue, creating imaging solutions that provide our customers with
quantifiable gains and real-world benefits. Carestream has always been here for you. We always will
be. Together, let’s continue to shape the future of imaging.
* [Board of Directors][64]
* [Executive Biographies][65]
* [Company History][66]
* [Company Profile (PDF)][67]

## Feature Spotlight

**[Smart Noise Cancellation for Superb Image Quality.][68]**

[ [Quality Solutions Built to Address Real Voice of Customer Needs] ][69]

**Provides clear, easier-to-read images for improved diagnostic confidence.**

Enables customers to lower radiation dose without loss in image quality. Performance validated in an
internal study with **50%** dose reduction from 220 IEC EI on average.*

[Learn More][70]

[Smart Noise Cancellation Brochure (PDF)][71]

## Latest Press Release

**Rochester, NY. May 21, 2026**

[ [Carestream Highlights Continued Business Momentum and Confidence] ][72]

**Carestream Highlights Continued Business Momentum and Confidence**


Following a comprehensive refinancing earlier this year, Carestream Health has received an upgrade
of its Corporate Family Rating and its outlook from Moody’s. The update reflects [[...][73]]
* [Read the full Release][74]
* [All News Releases][75]

* These statements were validated using Carestream CsI detectors in reader studies conducted by
board-certified radiologists. Pairwise comparisons were performed between images at nominal exposure
dose without SNC and at 50% reduced dose with SNC. The reduced-dose images included live patient
images with simulated dose reduction, as well as images of human cadavers and anthropomorphic
phantoms obtained using actual reduced-dose X-ray exposures. SNC performance was further confirmed
using a CDRAD phantom. IEC EI values on average at nominal and reduced dose were 220 and 110,
respectively.

Health (NIOSH) is deciding on expanding their federal program known as the “B Reader Program.” This
program trains and certifies physicians to read chest radiographs […]

Our fast and powerful diagnostic viewer, is built to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) to
enhance reading workflow, to support diagnostic accuracy and to enrich the user experience.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

"AGITO Medical is a company with a well-established reputation. We talked to several firms about

With 10,000+ OBD2 DTCs, 100+ supported car makes, and over 1 million users

worldwide, we’ve spent 11 years redefining automotive diagnostics.

###### 10000+ OBD2 DTCs

ANCEL's tools decode over 10,000 diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs)—from common engine warnings to rare
transmission glitches—helping you quickly identify and resolve engine, ABS, SRS, TPMS, and other
system faults with unmatched accuracy.

###### 100+ Car Makes

From mainstream to luxury vehicles, ANCEL scanners cover over 100 global brands—including American,
European, and Asian manufacturers—ensuring broad compatibility for both technicians and DIYers.

###### 11 Years of Innovation

Backed by more than a decade of research and development, ANCEL has continually pushed the
boundaries of automotive diagnostics to deliver smarter, faster, and more intuitive tools. Our tools
simplify complex workflows, offering both precision and ease of use.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

## Radiation Protection Products Made in USA

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

# Innovation in Radiation Protection Products & Technology

Engineered with superior performance against the harmful effects of ionizing radiation, our
lightweight,
protective aprons offer comfortable flexibility with a broad range of customization options.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

## Radiation Protection Products Made in USA

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

### [X-ray Protection Accessories][34]

In addition to our **x ray** radiation protection suit options, we also carry a wide range of
protective accessories. For example, we offer lead shield protection ranging from heavy-duty mobile
lead shielding to single-use secure shields for physicians and patients.

## Conclusion

Barrier Technologies is a global leader in the **radiation protective products** industry. We are a
company of motivated experts, engineers, and medical innovators with the common goal of
manufacturing the best radiation safety equipment in the world using the best **radiation shielding
**materials.

To this end, we take pride in our ability to accommodate all customization requests. With
inspiration from George Bernard Shaw, while some people see things how they are and say “Why?” We at
Barrier Technologies dream things that never were and say “Why not?”

Scan in a Snap
Capture documents, forms, slides, and whiteboards into high-quality PDFs using your mobile phone.

AI-Enhanced Scans

provide filters to retouch and improve the scans.

Export and share easily. Enjoy the convenience of wireless printing and send faxes to over 30
countries worldwide.
Extract Text
Instantly convert text from images into editable text. Supports recognition in 41 languages,
including English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Sync Across Devices
Sync and back up files for easy access on all your devices, anytime, anywhere.
Do More with Your Scans
Merge, split, add or delete pages, rearrange page order, compress, e-sign, and add watermarks to PDF
files.

email, or other methods, like Facebook, WhatsApp, and more.

document appearance.

Word, Excel, PPT, and image files.

# Large format scanners and imaging matter to us

At Contex we are passionate about creating industry-leading imaging solutions with our large format
scanners. We continuously strive to improve our business practices, products and services to provide
you with the very best.

[Large format scanner, IQ Quattro X close-up]

## Technology leadership

Delivering world-class large format scanners to over 100 countries, Contex solutions are recognized
by a wide range of industries for reliability, high performance and superb image quality.

We have earned our reputation as the market leader by developing state-of-the-art technology and
software for more than 100 years.

[Learn more about us][111]

## World-class partnerships

We want to make working with large format originals as easy for you as possible. Making sure that
your printer is compatible with our scanners is a big part of that quest. That is why we collaborate
with the best large format printer companies in the world to provide you with best-in-class printer
drivers.

  or outputting to a printer.

### Productivity and flexibility (1:31)

Delivering world-class large format scanners to over 100 countries, Contex solutions are recognized

software for more than 100 years.

We want to make working with large format originals as easy for you as possible. Making sure that

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

[3D Measurement Solutions][111]

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

# Every engagement makes the next one better. But only if the knowledge stays yours.

Dradis is a self-hosted, open-source penetration testing management platform. Your team's findings,
methodology, and Issue Library stay on infrastructure you control.
* Runs anywhere security work happens - on-premises, private cloud, or fully air-gapped secure
  networks.
* Junior consultants pull from findings vetted by seniors - on an open platform you can inspect and
  extend, not a black-box SaaS
* Project 100 benefits from everything your team learned in projects 1 through 99 - permanently, not
  contingent on a vendor's roadmap or pricing

[Get Started][57]
[Screenshot of Dradis' Project Summary view.]

### Trusted in by

[Find out why!][58]

## A knowledge system that gets smarter every time your team uses it
## and stays under your control

#### Foundation

We convert your existing report format and populate your Issue Library on day one. Your team ships
polished reports from their first engagement.

The open-source core means you can inspect, extend, and adapt the platform beyond what any API
exposes.

#### Refinement

Every finding your team writes and refines enriches the shared library. Your best XSS description,
your most defensible severity rationale - captured once, available to everyone, on every future
project. Not sitting in a PDF. Not on a vendor's server.

#### Compounding

Project 100 benefits from everything your team learned in projects 1 through 99. Junior consultants
pull from vetted findings and deliver output indistinguishable from a veteran's.

Because this runs on infrastructure you own - built on a GPLv2 core - that accumulated expertise is
permanently yours, regardless of what happens to the vendor landscape.

Medical Equipment. The company is a prime manufacturer and supplier of CT Scanners, Gamma Camera,
Sensation Cardiac CT Scanner, PET CT Scanners, MRI Scanners, Colour Doppler, Magnetom Verio MRI

Scanner, MRI Scanner, PET CT Scanner, SPECT Scanner, etc. With a motto to grow and attain success,
we have been offering excellent solutions to the hospitals in India around small and rural places.

# Professional 3D Scanning Solutions for Industry

## 3D Scanning
## Streamlines workflows
## Boosts productivity
## Ensures quality

eviXscan 3D specializes in the development of professional hardware and software for industrial 3D
scanning. Our structured light 3D scanners and metrology software are designed to deliver
exceptional speed, precision and reliability for quality control, reverse engineering and advanced
manufacturing applications.

[Contact Us][82]
×

### Technology
* [+ Emergency Power][83]
* [+ Solution Labore][84]
* [+ 100% Responsive][85]


## How eviXscan 3D Improves Quality Control and Manufacturing?

**eviXscan 3D** excels in creating high-quality **industrial 3D scanning solutions**, including
advanced **structured light 3D scanners**, sophisticated metrology software, and comprehensive 3D
scanning services.

Our products, founded on cutting-edge structured light technology, are renowned for their
**metrology-grade precision**, speed, and innovation, designed specifically for demanding
applications in **reverse engineering**, **non-contact quality control**, and rapid prototyping.

By significantly accelerating **quality control** processes and streamlining **industrial
manufacturing** workflows, eviXscan 3D solutions directly contribute to substantial cost savings for
businesses.

Accessible globally through an extensive reseller network, our **3D scanners** support
**automotive**, **heavy industry**, **defence**, **aerospace** and many other industries across
Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia, and Africa, enhancing operational efficiency and product
quality worldwide.

Our solutions are trusted by manufacturers across automotive, heavy industry, defence and aerospace
sectors. Whether you need high-precision **dimensional inspection**, **CAD comparison** or
**automated quality control**, eviXscan 3D provides reliable **optical metrology solutions** that
improve efficiency and reduce production costs.

### How can we help you today?


## 3D Scanning Solutions for Every Stage of Your Workflow

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.
* #### Reliability you can trust
  
  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

exocad’s software solutions are distributed by a global network of trusted partners who also provide
easy-to-access after-sales service like installations, training and technical support. For product
support, offers or more information, please contact one of our partners.

## Summer school is in session

Ready for hot tips and cool new workflows? Join our amazing application specialists for our upcoming
summer school webinar series. From boosting case acceptance to accelerating design proposals with
AI, these classes will help make your work a breeze on the steamiest summer day.

[See schedule][74]

## Powerful new PartialCAD 3.3 Chemnitz release available now!

PartialCAD 3.3 Chemnitz introduces a highly automated, guided split denture workflow that simplifies
design and speeds up production. From precise bar tops to enhanced post tools and automatic gingiva
thickness control, this release helps you achieve consistent, high-quality results with ease.

[Learn more][75]

[exocad HP slider PartialCAD Chemnitz]

## Browse our exocad webshop

Upgrade your *DentalCAD* license or purchase add-on modules anytime, anywhere from our exocad
webshop. We'll even help out with the initial installation and configuration of your new software
solution.

[Shop now][76]

[Webshop Grafik exocad HP slider]
[exoBlog HP banner Janos Panyi]

 

For many dental students, digital dentistry is still limited to a few classroom exercises. For Dr.
János Panyi, his curiosity pushed him to dive into digital long before graduation. In this exoBlog,
we hear how discovering exocad software through the student license helped János hone the skills he
now uses every day in practice.

[Read the interview][77]

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.
* #### Reliability you can trust
  
  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

## How to purchase exocad software

exocad’s software solutions are distributed by a global network of trusted partners who also provide
easy-to-access after-sales service like installations, training and technical support. For product
support, offers or more information, please contact one of our partners.

Please note: ChairsideCAD and exoplan are certified as Medical Devices for distribution in selected
countries only. For further details please contact your reseller.

The Problem

## Reduce complexity that wastes your time and money

In today's world, internal and external vulnerability scanning is critical to manage your attack
surface, detect exploitable vulnerabilities before attackers, and fully validate your remediations.

With increasingly sophisticated cyber attacks, IT teams must also juggle high operational complexity
and inflexible allegiances to single vendors for core services.

68%

of cyber breaches involve human error. **Verizon**

3 months

External vulnerability scanning is run on average every 3 months. It should run daily. **PCI DSS**

60%

A single vulnerability scan on average covers only 60% of your exposure. **SANS Institute**

10+ hours

Teams spend 10+ hours per week managing their scanning providers. **Dark Reading**

The Solution

### HostedScan is fast and powerful, providing the world's most complete coverage at a fraction of
### the cost and complexity.

In a perfect world, you can run scans and detect vulnerabilities with any of the world's top
cybersecurity tools, all in one integrated platform built for speed.

### Mitigate security vulnerabilities

Discover CVEs, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, and exploitable weaknesses across your entire
infrastructure. Get prioritized remediation guidance with CVSS scoring and actionable risk
classifications—fix what matters first.

[Learn more][11]

### Manage your risk exposure

With regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, failure to maintain reasonable security procedures is
grounds for lawsuits and fines.

[Get started][12]

### Meet compliance requirements

Vulnerability scanning is essential for your compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, cyber insurance, and
more.

[Learn more][13]

### Detect misconfigurations

90% of cyber attacks exploit simple misconfigurations, not zero-days. Detect exposed ports, weak
credentials, outdated software, and common security gaps before attackers do—automatically, every
day.

[Get started][14]

### Map your attack surface

Your infrastructure changes constantly. Automatically discover and monitor all websites, servers,
networks, and APIs—maintaining complete visibility of your attack surface without manual tracking.

## See the issue

Directly access complete data for all of your products. Catch problems early to keep lines moving.
* Voids, inclusions, and contamination
* Misalignment, missing features, and assembly errors
* Out-of-tolerance dimensions and geometric drift
* Cracks, fractures, and delamination

[
See for yourself
][66]

## Solve the problem

Correlate findings with process data across lines and sites. Isolate cause and quantify risk.
* Link each unit to machine, station, shift, and settings
* Detect trends and drift with control limits
* Map lineage across lots, suppliers, and materials
* Generate evidence-backed root-cause reports

## Ship the product

Turn diagnosis into action on the line. Release with proof, hold or rework when needed, and prevent
escapes.
* Pass/fail rules and release/hold decisions
* Alerts and standard work to stations and teams
* Accelerated, informed CAPAs grounded in evidence
* Run charts and thresholds to keep processes in control

Casting leak path. One week saved.

## 3 days of analysis reduced to 1

Aluminum engine housings were failing leak tests at one of Nemak’s plants. Lumafield CT revealed
shrinkage-based internal porosity, tied them to low fast-shot velocity, and guided a staged
water-cooling change that removed elongated pores, reduced scrap, and accelerated feedback.

Read the full story

> We saved nearly a full week getting the correct porosity characterization.

Analysis turnaround

12 → 3

Leak eliminated; scrap levels slashed.

> through one collaborative platform.

## Truth you can ship

When patient safety, mission success, or brand reputation is on the line, the proof is in the
product. Leaders across these industries figured that out first.
Medical Devices
Patient safety and compliance require internal proof for every device. Inspect sealed assemblies and
trace results to lot and serial.
[
Explore
][70]
Automotive
Recalls and warranty exposure make internal evidence non-negotiable. Catch issues at the source and
protect launch schedules.
[
Explore
][71]
Consumer Goods
Your brand reputation rides on every product. Validate internal components, fill, and seals to
prevent complaints and returns.
[
Explore
][72]
Aerospace & Defense
Flight and mission success demand unit-level evidence. Reveal voids, misbonds, and wiring faults,
then document root cause for release.
[
Explore
][73]
Batteries & Energy
Cell and pack integrity define performance and safety. Catch voids, misalignment, and contamination
before it’s too late.
[
Explore
][74]
Consumer Electronics
Tight tolerances and dense assemblies leave no room for guesswork. See inside PCBs and enclosures
and keep releases on track.

Why Now

## Quality is becoming a board-level conversation

Boards and shareholders are waking up to quality risk. Faced with the threats of recalls, reputation
damage, and supply chain exposure, the companies treating visibility as a strategic priority are
pulling ahead.

> This is the holy grail of what we’ve been talking about for years.

CEO, independent testing and certification organization

> We were impressed right out the gate by how easy the tools were to use and how fast our engineers
> got up to speed.

Failure Analysis Manager, Fortune 500 semiconductor company

> I see Lumafield’s platform as our solution for operationalizing all of our product lines.

Head of Quality, global agriscience leader

# Let’s assess your program

Tell us about your products, timelines, and constraints. We’ll review your goals, share a
recommendation, and outline the fastest path to value. That may look like an assessment, a pilot on
one line, or resources to help you get ready.

You’ll get the most value if:
* Your products have internal complexity that affects safety, performance, or cost
* Escapes, scrap, or rework are material line items
* You have a live line or near-term ramp where speed matters
* You can pilot on one cell with a path to scale
If you’re early in the process:
* We’re still happy to help
* We’ll point you to the right next step, even if it’s not us
* Book a short intro to see what’s possible
* Share a sample or CAD so we can advise
look within

## The question isn’t whether you need to know. It’s can you afford not to.

Request a Visibility Assessment to see what you’ve been missing and what it’s costing you.

of quarantined inventory cleared
Products

## Custom solutions give you the full picture.

Hardware to pinpoint problems + software to solve them.
[
Industrial X-ray CT scanner
/ Neptune
From initial design to mass manufacturing, Neptune accelerates your product development by giving
you X-ray vision.
][61][
AI-powered analysis software
/ Voyager
A groundbreaking, AI-enhanced analysis tool for scan data. Visualize, analyze, and share data from
any 3D or volumetric scanner with nothing but a web browser.
][62][
Production-ready CT scans in an instant
/ TRITON
Deploy CT 100x faster than ever before. Take full control of your manufacturing process with
automated scanning and real-time decision making at scale.
][63][
In-Line Arrayed X-Ray System
/ MARS
Inspect 100% of parts at full production speed. Catch defects the moment they occur, accelerate
quality decisions, and build a live view of production performance.
][64]
/ coming soon
New systems designed for metrology-grade dimensioning, large parts, and in-line inspection.
[
Learn more
][65]
Platform

## Manufacturing needs an operating system.

Inspect every unit, identify issues, and improve outcomes within a single unified system. Monitor
your entire operation in real time, from the lab to the factory floor.

Discover
01
Diagnose
02
Deliver
03

## See the issue

Directly access complete data for all of your products. Catch problems early to keep lines moving.
* Voids, inclusions, and contamination
* Misalignment, missing features, and assembly errors
* Out-of-tolerance dimensions and geometric drift
* Cracks, fractures, and delamination

[
See for yourself
][66]

## Solve the problem

Correlate findings with process data across lines and sites. Isolate cause and quantify risk.
* Link each unit to machine, station, shift, and settings
* Detect trends and drift with control limits
* Map lineage across lots, suppliers, and materials
* Generate evidence-backed root-cause reports

## Ship the product

Turn diagnosis into action on the line. Release with proof, hold or rework when needed, and prevent
escapes.
* Pass/fail rules and release/hold decisions
* Alerts and standard work to stations and teams
* Accelerated, informed CAPAs grounded in evidence
* Run charts and thresholds to keep processes in control

Casting leak path. One week saved.

## 3 days of analysis reduced to 1

Aluminum engine housings were failing leak tests at one of Nemak’s plants. Lumafield CT revealed
shrinkage-based internal porosity, tied them to low fast-shot velocity, and guided a staged
water-cooling change that removed elongated pores, reduced scrap, and accelerated feedback.

[
Read the full story
][67]
Quote

> We saved nearly a full week getting the correct porosity characterization.

Analysis turnaround
3 days → 1 day
labor Hours
12 → 3
Outcome
Leak eliminated; scrap levels slashed.
From Our Customers

> Lumafield helps us streamline development and production across international business units
> through one collaborative platform.

—Kirstyn Hein, Mechanical Engineer, Eaton
[
See how they did it
][68][
Explore stories
][69]
Industries

## Truth you can ship

When patient safety, mission success, or brand reputation is on the line, the proof is in the
product. Leaders across these industries figured that out first.
Medical Devices
Patient safety and compliance require internal proof for every device. Inspect sealed assemblies and
trace results to lot and serial.
[
Explore
][70]
Automotive
Recalls and warranty exposure make internal evidence non-negotiable. Catch issues at the source and
protect launch schedules.
[
Explore
][71]
Consumer Goods
Your brand reputation rides on every product. Validate internal components, fill, and seals to
prevent complaints and returns.
[
Explore
][72]
Aerospace & Defense
Flight and mission success demand unit-level evidence. Reveal voids, misbonds, and wiring faults,
then document root cause for release.
[
Explore
][73]
Batteries & Energy
Cell and pack integrity define performance and safety. Catch voids, misalignment, and contamination
before it’s too late.
[
Explore
][74]
Consumer Electronics
Tight tolerances and dense assemblies leave no room for guesswork. See inside PCBs and enclosures
and keep releases on track.
[
Explore
][75]
Why Now

## Quality is becoming a board-level conversation

Boards and shareholders are waking up to quality risk. Faced with the threats of recalls, reputation
damage, and supply chain exposure, the companies treating visibility as a strategic priority are
pulling ahead.

> This is the holy grail of what we’ve been talking about for years.

CEO, independent testing and certification organization

> We were impressed right out the gate by how easy the tools were to use and how fast our engineers
> got up to speed.

Failure Analysis Manager, Fortune 500 semiconductor company

> I see Lumafield’s platform as our solution for operationalizing all of our product lines.

Head of Quality, global agriscience leader

# Let’s assess your program

Tell us about your products, timelines, and constraints. We’ll review your goals, share a
recommendation, and outline the fastest path to value. That may look like an assessment, a pilot on
one line, or resources to help you get ready.

You’ll get the most value if:
* Your products have internal complexity that affects safety, performance, or cost
* Escapes, scrap, or rework are material line items
* You have a live line or near-term ramp where speed matters
* You can pilot on one cell with a path to scale
If you’re early in the process:
* We’re still happy to help
* We’ll point you to the right next step, even if it’s not us
* Book a short intro to see what’s possible
* Share a sample or CAD so we can advise
look within

## The question isn’t whether you need to know. It’s can you afford not to.

Request a Visibility Assessment to see what you’ve been missing and what it’s costing you.

# ABOUT MICROTEK

Founded in 1980, Microtek International, Inc. is headquartered in Science-based Industry Park in
Hsinchu, Taiwan. MICROTEK has grown from a small start-up team to a multi-national company with a
well-established distribution and global service network.

MICROTEK has been producing innovative scanning solutions for over three decades, and still
continues to make technology breakthroughs in scanning solutions. Therefore, MICROTEK is proud to
lay claim to a number of industry firsts since the world's first 300-dpi black-and-white sheet-fed
scanner in 1985. Holding over 450 patents worldwide, Microtek remains to develop next-generation
digital imaging solutions, such as medical, industrial and bio. solutions.

break free from the Infrastructure Trap. For more than 35 years, we’ve been the trusted partner for

# Mobile Imaging Labs and Cleanrooms

## Turnkey Imaging and Cleanroom Solutions for Precision Applications

You’re on a mission to grow, innovate, and deliver—without being slowed down by outdated imaging and
cleanroom infrastructure. Rigid systems and complex construction projects put your momentum at risk,
creating delays, compliance headaches, and unnecessary costs. That’s what we call the Infrastructure
Trap—and too many organizations get stuck in it.

At Modular Devices, we’ve helped leaders in healthcare, life sciences, technology, and manufacturing
break free from the Infrastructure Trap. For more than 35 years, we’ve been the trusted partner for
teams like yours who need compliant, flexible imaging and cleanroom space fast.

[ Contact Us ][66]

## Flexible Imaging and Cleanroom Solutions for Your Critical Needs

Our modular [imaging][67] and [cleanroom][68] suites are designed around your needs—delivered fast,
reducing risk and eliminating disruption to your operations. Whether a stock standard offering from
our lease fleet or a more tailored solution, we’ll help you define your space requirements,
streamline the project scope, and deliver a turnkey imaging or cleanroom solution that meets your
timeline and budget.

[
[Modular Devices - Imaging]
Learn More
About Imaging

Gaps in imaging capabilities can disrupt care, strain staff, and impact patient outcomes. That’s why
we provide turnkey mobile and modular imaging labs for cardiac care, Mobile MRI, and CT Scanners
—engineered in house, delivered quickly, and supported by industry experts.

][69] [
[Modular Devices - Cleanrooms]
Learn More
About Cleanrooms

Our leasable pre-built outdoor mobile cleanrooms and standardized modular wall panel cleanrooms are
constructed for the strict demands of highly regulated industries, including biopharma, radiopharma,
healthcare & compounding pharmacy, aerospace, specialty chemical, and semiconductor. From leasable
mobile cleanrooms to predefined modular wall panel cleanroom builds to customized cleanroom
solutions, we enable your success without compromise.

[Side View Pharmacy Compounding Cleanroom]
][70]

You’re leading change and we’re here to make sure infrastructure doesn’t hold you back. Get the
space you need, when and where you need it—so you can keep moving forward, stay compliant, and never
feel stuck again.
* **Industry Leaders** – More than 35 years ago, we pioneered the mobile imaging industry and
  continue to provide innovative, end-to-end solutions to meet the evolving challenges of our
  customers.
* **Experts in Mobile and Modular Design** – In-house design, engineering, quality, operations,
  construction, and maintenance teams with a deep understanding of critical environments.
* **Turnkey Imaging and Cleanroom Solutions** – From utilities hook-up to testing, we handle
  everything for a complete installation.
* **Fully Customizable** – Not all spaces are created equal. When our standard mobile units don’t
  quite meet your needs, our team is ready to design and build a custom solution.
* **Nationwide Reach** – With installations across the continental US and Hawaii, we understand and
  design to meet strict state regulations and local building codes.

# NAPS2 - Not Another PDF Scanner

### Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible.

### Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible.

NAPS2 is free and open source scanning software for [Windows][6], [Mac][7] and [Linux][8].

Easily scan with devices from Canon, Brother, HP, Epson, Fujitsu, and more. Then save to PDF, TIFF,
JPEG, or PNG with a single click.

[ Download NAPS2 Version 8.3.2 · Windows ][9] [ Download NAPS2 Version 8.3.2 · Windows ][10] [ More
Files ][11] [ [Download from the Microsoft Store] ][12]

## Use the best drivers for your scanner

Choose between WIA and TWAIN drivers, whichever works better for your scanner. Also choose settings
like DPI, page size, and bit depth. Scan from a flatbed or automatic document feeder (ADF),
including duplex support.

## Rotate, crop, and rearrange images

Drag and drop your pages into whatever order you like. Interleave pages for manual duplex scanning.
Rotate your pages by hand or automatically deskew to the right angle. Use image editing tools to
crop or change brightness and contrast.

## Identify text using OCR

Search through text included in your PDFs by using optical character recognition (OCR), in any of
over 100 languages.

## Use NAPS2 in your native language

Choose from over 40 different languages. If your language isn't available yet, [help translate!][13]

## Share scanners across the network

Use scanners connected to other computers on your local network. Turn any scanner into a wireless
scanner usable from your laptop or phone. [Read more.][14]

## Tools for power users and businesses

* Optional [command-line interface (CLI)][15] for automation and scripting
* [NAPS2.Sdk][16] scanning library for .NET developers
* [MSI installer][17] and [application-level configuration][18] available for group policy (GPO)
  deployment
* [Portable archives][19] available (doesn't require installation)

## Free and open source

NAPS2 is completely free to use for both individuals and businesses, and includes no ads or unwanted
software. If NAPS2 has helped you, consider making a donation.

## Online QR Code Scanner FAQ

[QR Code Scanner Online] How to scan a QR code?

Using our online QR code scanner is very simple. You just need to visit our tool page through a
browser and select the scanning method according to your device:
1. **Computer users::** Allow the browser to access your computer camera and automatically identify
   the QR code/barcode by placing it within the camera range.
2. **Mobile/tablet users::** You can also use the mobile phone camera directly for real-time
   scanning.
3. **Image recognition::** If the QR code/barcode exists in the image, you can choose to upload a
   local image (support JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG, WEBP, BMP and other formats), and the tool will
   automatically decode and identify it.

[How to scan a QR code?][24]
[QR Code Scanner Online] Can I export scan results to Excel or Word?

Yes, our professional engine supports bulk scanning. You can instantly export your entire scan
history to Excel, CSV, Word, or TXT files for efficient inventory and data management.

[QR Code Scanner Online] How do I scan a QR code from a screenshot?

Save the screenshot as an image file (recommended PNG or JPG format) and upload it to the online
tool to decode the QR code content without cropping or preprocessing.

[How do I scan a QR code from a screenshot?][25]
[QR Code Scanner Online] Is it safe to scan QR codes on this site??

Absolutely. We prioritize privacy by processing all images locally in your browser. No files are
uploaded to any server, providing a 100% secure scanning experience.

[QR Code Scanner Online] How to use the online QR code scanner?

Using our online QR code scanner is very simple. You just need to visit our tool page through a
browser and select the scanning method according to your device:
1. **Computer users::** Allow the browser to access your computer camera and automatically identify
   the QR code/barcode by placing it within the camera range.
2. **Mobile/tablet users::** You can also use the mobile phone camera directly for real-time
   scanning.
3. **Image recognition::** If the QR code/barcode exists in the image, you can choose to upload a
   local image (support JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG, WEBP, BMP and other formats), and the tool will
   automatically decode and identify it.

[How to use the online QR code scanner?][26]
[QR Code Scanner Online] What types of QR codes does the online QR code scanner support?

Our online QR code scanner is powerful and can accurately identify many common types of QR codes to
meet your needs in different scenarios. It supports parsing the following QR code content:
1.  **URL link:** After scanning, you can jump directly to any web page, whether it is a product
    detail page, event registration link or personal blog, you can easily access it.
2.  **Plain text (Text):** Decode any text information contained in the QR code, such as serial
    numbers, product descriptions, or short messages.
3.  **Location (Location):** Identify geographic coordinate information and directly display the
    specific location in the map application for easy navigation or viewing.
4.  **Wi-Fi connection:** Quickly identify the name (SSID), password, and encryption type of the
    Wi-Fi network, and easily connect to the wireless network after scanning.
5.  **Electronic business card (vCard):** After scanning, you can directly import contact
    information, including name, phone number, email address, company, etc., eliminating the trouble
    of manual input.
6.  **SMS (SMS):** Automatically generate SMS drafts with preset recipients and content, so that you
    can quickly send messages.
7.  **Phone number (Call):** After scanning, you can directly dial the preset phone number, which is
    especially suitable for customer service hotlines or emergency contacts.
8.  **Calendar event (Event):** Identify the detailed information of calendar events, such as event
    name, time, location, etc., so that you can add them to the calendar with one click.
9.  **Email (Mail):** Automatically create a draft email with preset recipients, subject and
    content, allowing you to easily send emails.
10. No matter what kind of QR code you encounter, our online tool can provide you with efficient and
    accurate recognition services.

[What types of QR codes does the online QR code scanner support?][27]
[QR Code Scanner Online] What are the significant advantages of using an online QR code scanning
tool?

Our online QR code scanner has the following advantages:
1. **All-platform compatibility:** No need to download and install any software, it can be used on
   all mainstream systems and devices such as Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, etc.
2. **Intelligent high-precision recognition:** Adopting an intelligent recognition engine to ensure
   fast and accurate parsing of QR code/barcode content.
3. **Multi-function result processing:** The scan results support instant editing, one-click
   sharing, copying and downloading.
4. **Batch export function:** Specially provide batch scanning result export function, which can
   automatically generate and save as Word, Excel, PDF, Google Sheets, CSV, TXT files, greatly
   improving data management efficiency.

At PET Scan Lucknow, we provide top-quality PET scan services using the latest technology, including

## PET Scan Services Starting from ₹*****

We offer PET scan services starting from ₹***** to help identify and monitor various health
conditions. Whether you need a regular checkup or a specialized scan, our modern equipment provides
clear and accurate results for your peace of mind.

Choose us for affordable pricing, quick appointment scheduling, and a comfortable environment. Our
commitment to excellence and patient-centered approach makes us the trusted choice for PET scans in
Lucknow.

[Call Now][6]

## A Diagnostic Centre that Values Accuracy & Customers

We provide PET scan services to help identify and monitor various health conditions. Whether you

## PET Scan In Lucknow – Best Price & Advanced Tech

At PET Scan Lucknow, we are committed to delivering precise and affordable diagnostic imaging
services. We use state-of-the-art Positron Emission Tomography (PET) technology to provide advanced
imaging solutions that ensure accurate diagnoses with swift turnaround times and expert medical
consultations.
* PET Scan service starting at ₹*****
* 24/7 Appointment Booking and Support
* Home Report Delivery at No Extra Cost
* Expert Radiologists for Precise Diagnoses
* Complimentary Transportation Services

[Book Your PET Scan][8]

## PET Scan Lucknow Queries

What is a PET scan and why is it needed?

A PET scan, or Positron Emission Tomography scan, is a type of imaging test that helps doctors see
how your organs and tissues are functioning. It is commonly used to detect and monitor diseases such

## Your Guide to Find the Best PET Scan Centre in Lucknow

Positron Emission Tomography scanning represents a sophisticated breakthrough in medical imaging
technology. This advanced diagnostic tool provides physicians with intricate details about how
organs and tissues function at the cellular level. 

Unlike traditional imaging methods, PET scans reveal metabolic processes within the body, offering
invaluable insights into various health conditions. The technology works by detecting areas of high
cellular activity, which often indicate the presence of disease before structural changes become
visible through other imaging methods.

### Selecting the Right Centre in Lucknow

The choice of a [PET scan center][13] significantly influences the accuracy and reliability of your
diagnostic results. Premium centers in Lucknow house cutting-edge scanning equipment maintained
according to international standards. These facilities typically employ the latest generation
scanners with hybrid capabilities, combining PET with CT technology for enhanced diagnostic
precision.

The expertise of the medical team plays a crucial role in accurate diagnosis. Leading centers employ
nuclear medicine specialists with extensive experience in interpreting scan results. Their technical
staff undergoes regular training to stay current with technological advancements and proper patient
care protocols.

The facility’s physical environment merits careful consideration. Superior centers maintain pristine
conditions with strict hygiene protocols and radiation safety measures. They provide comfortable
waiting areas and private preparation rooms. Staff members offer clear, detailed instructions and
remain available to address concerns throughout the process.

### How does PET Scanning work?

The scanning process begins with carefully preparing a radioactive tracer, typically a form of
glucose carrying a radioactive atom. This substance gets injected into your bloodstream, where it
travels throughout your body. Disease-affected cells, which typically consume more glucose than
healthy cells, absorb this tracer more readily.

After injection, patients rest quietly for about an hour, allowing the tracer to distribute properly
throughout the body. During this time, moving around is minimized to ensure even distribution. The
actual scanning procedure takes approximately 30 minutes, during which the scanner detects gamma
rays emitted by the tracer, creating detailed three-dimensional images of internal body processes.

### **Types of PET Scans**

#### Whole Body PET Scan

This comprehensive scanning procedure examines the entire body, proving invaluable for cancer
detection, staging, and monitoring. The scan reveals how cancer cells behave differently from normal
cells, showing their increased glucose consumption.

It effectively detects primary tumors and any metastatic spread, helping physicians determine the
most appropriate treatment strategy. Regular whole-body scans during treatment help evaluate therapy
effectiveness and identify any potential recurrence early.

#### Brain PET Scan

Brain-specific scans provide detailed insights into neurological conditions by measuring glucose
metabolism and blood flow in different brain regions. These scans prove particularly valuable for:

DementiEarly detection of Alzheimer’s disease by showing reduced brain activity in specific areas. 
* Epilepsy: Identifying seizure focal points by revealing areas of abnormal brain metabolism 
* Brain Tumors: Distinguishing between tumor recurrence and radiation necrosis 
* Psychiatric Disorders: Understanding brain function patterns in conditions like depression and
  schizophrenia

# Find Your Target Audience For Email, Direct and Cold Calling Campaigns

## Direct Marketing Lists

### Business Lists

### Business Lists

Business lists are used by businesses who want to promote their service or product to other
businesses.
[ Business Lists ][87]

### Consumer Lists

### Consumer Lists

[ Build Your Lists ][88]

### Specialty Lists

### Specialty Lists

Most of the time our clients are just looking for basic business or consumer lists to market to, but
sometimes a generic marketing list just won’t do.

[ Specialty Lists ][89]

## What Are List Brokers and How Can They Help Your Business?

A list broker is a marketing professional who acts as an intermediary between businesses seeking
targeted prospects and the companies that own or manage marketing databases. Rather than spending
countless hours researching and comparing thousands of list options, businesses partner with list
brokers to quickly identify, procure, and deploy the most effective marketing lists for their
campaigns.

#### What List Brokers Do?
* Access 70,000+ lists from multiple sources
* Provide unbiased recommendations
* Negotiate competitive pricing
* Ensure data accuracy and compliance
* Guide campaign strategy

#### Why Use a List Broker?
* Save 20-40 hours of research time
* Avoid costly list mistakes
* Get expert targeting advice
* Access lists not publicly available

manufacturer and solution provider of environmental & weather monitoring for 15+ years. 

 

Rika Sensor is committed to developing and providing intelligent and cost-effective IoT
environmental monitoring products and services, including: wind measurement, solar radiation
measurement, weather sensors, temperature and humidity measurement, hydro-meteorological
measurement, soil moisture measurement, water quality measurement, ICT liquid cooling water quality

Hunan Rika Electronic Tech Co., Ltd, located in Changsha, is a privately held weather sensor
manufacturer and solution provider of environmental & weather monitoring for 15+ years. 

 

Rika Sensor is committed to developing and providing intelligent and cost-effective IoT
environmental monitoring products and services, including: wind measurement, solar radiation
measurement, weather sensors, temperature and humidity measurement, hydro-meteorological
measurement, soil moisture measurement, water quality measurement, ICT liquid cooling water quality
monitoring, data loggers, environmental sensors and various weather stations and meteorological
monitoring stations.

ICT liquid cooling systems, solar energy, smart agriculture, aquaculture, sewage treatment, air
quality monitoring, wind power generation and other meteorological and environmental monitoring

systems. It provides a single point of communications for multiple measurement devices and offers a
simple solution for managing control pressures to pressure scanners, along with a wealth of other
features that make the ECM unique and highly customizable.

simple solution for managing control pressures to pressure scanners, along with a wealth of other
features that make the ECM unique and highly customizable.

[ Galvanometer Scanner Series ][173]
Scanner Optics independently develops and produces a series of laser scanning heads (7mm, 10mm,
14mm, 20mm, 30mm, 50mm), voice coil motor and optical galvanometer system based on motion control
technology, including 3D large area dynamic focusing system, high power galvanometer welding system,
5-axes drilling galvanometer, 4-axes platform linkage galvanometer, polygon scanning galvanometer,
medical aesthetic fractional galvanometer, and weld tracking detection system. Serialized optical
scanner solutions have been successfully applied in mobile phone 3C industry, food packaging,
tobacco industry, medical technology and other fields.

[ About
Scanner Optics ][214]

Scanner Optics Co.,Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise integrating technology research and
development, production and sales of optical scanning devices. We are committed to providing F-theta
lens, encoder and galvo scanning system solutions for global customers.

 

Scanner Optics has a strong R&D team of optics, mechanical, electronics, software and process
testing, and has obtained a dozens of utility model patents, invention patents and software
copyrights. In addition to developing standard galvo scanning system and marking controllers, we
also provide customers with customized galvoscanner solutions. Our products include ultra-galvo
scanners, extra-galvo scanners, BLDC motor, voice coil motors, ultra-galvo scan heads, extra-galvo
scan heads, Hashu intelligent scan head, 3D large field dynamic focusing system, polygon scanning
system, four-axis synchronizing motion system, five-axis laser micromachining system, optical
coherence tomography scan module and medical fractional laser system, etc.

[8+ Ductless AC Unit Costs: 2024 Price Guide]

The cost of ductless air conditioning systems, also known as mini-splits, depends on several
factors, including the system’s size (measured in British Thermal Units or BTUs), the number of
zones or rooms being cooled, the specific brand and model chosen, and the complexity of the
installation process. A single-zone system, suitable for cooling a small room, might cost
significantly less than a multi-zone system designed for an entire house. Additional features, such
as energy efficiency ratings (SEER and HSPF) and smart home integration, can also influence the
overall expenditure.

These systems offer significant advantages over traditional central air conditioning, particularly
in terms of energy efficiency and targeted cooling. By eliminating the need for ductwork, energy
loss associated with leaky ducts is avoided. The ability to control the temperature in individual
zones allows for customized comfort and further reduces energy consumption. This targeted approach
can lead to substantial long-term cost savings and a smaller environmental footprint compared to
whole-house cooling systems. The technology itself has evolved significantly over the years,
resulting in quieter operation, improved performance, and a wider range of available options for
consumers.

## [Contesting a Will: Cost & Legal Fees Guide][20]

July 27, 2026 by [sadmin][21]
[ [how much does it cost to contest a will] ][22]

[how much does it cost to contest a will]

[Contesting a Will: Cost & Legal Fees Guide]

Challenging the legality of a deceased individual’s testamentary document involves various expenses,
including court fees, executor fees, attorney fees, and potentially the costs associated with expert
witnesses such as handwriting analysts or medical professionals. These expenses can vary
significantly depending on the complexity of the case, the jurisdiction, and the length of the legal
proceedings. For instance, a simple case with minimal disputes might involve lower costs, while a
complex case involving multiple beneficiaries and substantial assets could incur significantly
higher expenses.

Ensuring a fair distribution of assets according to the deceased’s true wishes is paramount. Legal
challenges to a will serve as a crucial mechanism to address potential fraud, undue influence, or
lack of testamentary capacity. Historically, the ability to contest a will has evolved alongside
societal understanding of individual rights and property ownership. This legal avenue protects
vulnerable beneficiaries and upholds the integrity of the estate settlement process. It provides a
means for rectifying potential injustices and ensuring that the final wishes of the deceased are
respected, or at least accurately interpreted and legally sound.

[Contesting a Will: Cost & Legal Fees Guide]

including court fees, executor fees, attorney fees, and potentially the costs associated with expert
witnesses such as handwriting analysts or medical professionals. These expenses can vary
significantly depending on the complexity of the case, the jurisdiction, and the length of the legal
proceedings. For instance, a simple case with minimal disputes might involve lower costs, while a
complex case involving multiple beneficiaries and substantial assets could incur significantly
higher expenses.

Ensuring a fair distribution of assets according to the deceased’s true wishes is paramount. Legal
challenges to a will serve as a crucial mechanism to address potential fraud, undue influence, or
lack of testamentary capacity. Historically, the ability to contest a will has evolved alongside
societal understanding of individual rights and property ownership. This legal avenue protects
vulnerable beneficiaries and upholds the integrity of the estate settlement process. It provides a
means for rectifying potential injustices and ensuring that the final wishes of the deceased are
respected, or at least accurately interpreted and legally sound.
