## Popular Products

[View All Products][102]
[
][103]
SDX 10060 XDi
Providing highly accurate material discrimination and substance identification, the SDX 10060 XDi
allows for exceptional detection of powders, liquids, and solids.
[See product][104]
[
][105]
IONSCAN 600
IONSCAN 600 is a highly sensitive, non-radioactive, lightweight, portable desktop system that
detects and identifies trace amounts of explosives and narcotics.
[See product][106]
[
][107]
iCMORE
Our object recognition software, iCMORE, uses advanced algorithms to reduce the burden on operators
– and potential errors – by automating the detection process for suspicious items within inspected
cargo, baggage or palleted goods.
[See product][108]
[
][109]
HI-SCAN 6040 CTiX
Meeting the highest available regulatory standards, the HI SCAN 6040 CTiX is available with ECAC EDS
CB C3 approval and TSA APSS 6.2 Level 1 certification.
[See product][110]
[
][111]
LCD 4 - Including XID
A rugged and reliable chemical-warfare agent identifier and TIC detector, the LCD has been in
continuous production for over 25 years and is globally the most widely deployed detector of
chemical warfare agents.
[See product][112]
[
][113]
HI-SCAN 6040 DV
An advanced dual-view X-ray inspection system for automatic explosives and liquids detection at
Urban Security and Aviation checkpoints.
[See product][114]
[
][115]
HI-SCAN 6040C
Designed to screen bags and parcels for prohibited and dangerous items, the HI-SCAN 6040C is ideal
for screening at building entrances.
[See product][116]
[
][117]
B-SCAN
The non-invasive B-SCAN people screening series detects objects and threats concealed in-or-on the
body.
[See product][118]
[
][119]
HI-SCAN 5030C
A transportable and lightweight X-ray scanner, ideal for screening in mail rooms or building
entrances, including: courthouses, schools, event venues, stadiums or correctional facilities.
[See product][120]
[
][121]
HI-SCAN 6040-2is HR
An advanced dual-view X-ray inspection system for the automatic detection of solid and liquid
explosives in checked baggage.
[See product][122]
[
][123]
CTX 9800 DSi
ECAC Standard 3 approved and TSA certified explosives detection system (EDS) suitable for
identifying threats in checked baggage and cargo packages.
[See product][124]
[
][125]
HI-SCAN 10080 XCT
Complying with current TSA and ECAC regulations, the HI-SCAN 10080 XCT is a next generation
high-speed, explosives detection system for hold baggage and air cargo.
[See product][126]
[
][127]
HCVM
Available as either a mobile cargo vehicle or a trailer, the HCVM X-ray screening system optimizes
security checks at airports, ports and borders.
[See product][128]
[
][129]
HI-SCAN 180180-2is pro
An X-ray scanner designed for the inspection of large scale consolidated and palletised goods, ideal
for cargo inspection.
[See product][130]
[
][131]
HI-SCAN 145180-2is
Universal X-ray system for palletised items, ideal for use in warehouses. Dual view for shorter
inspection times.
[See product][132]
[
][133]
HI-SCAN 7555si
With large tunnel dimensions and an advanced multi energy X-ray generator, the HI-SCAN 7555si
provides high quality image analysis of baggage and parcels.
[See product][134]
[
][135]
ScanVan
Customized to meet user needs, the ScanVan integrates Smiths Detection's HI-SCAN X-ray technology to
screen freight, luggage or mail.
[See product][136]
[
][137]
HI-SCAN 6046si
Utilizing high resolution XADA detector modules, the HI-SCAN 6046si produces extremely detailed
X-ray images of screened baggage and parcels.
[See product][138]
[
][139]
HI-SCAN 10080 EDX-2is
Using a dual view X-ray system, the HI-SCAN 10080 EDX-2is improved the evaluation process allows
operators to ‘look behind’ objects while automatically screening baggage for explosives.
[See product][140]
[
][141]
CTX 5800
A compact explosives detection system (EDS), the CTX 5800 identifies threats in checked baggage and
cargo packages.
[See product][142]
[
][143]
iLane A20
iLane A20 was designed to increase throughput, reduce queues and improve operational efficiency at
aviation passenger checkpoints. This intelligent lane has evolved from our extensive experience in
integrated checkpoints and meets the most demanding customer requirements.
[See product][144]
[
][145]
SDX 100100 DV HC
The SDX 100100 DV HC series delivers high throughput break-bulk freight and oversized baggage
screening
[See product][146]
[
][147]
HI-SCAN 145180-2is pro
The innovative air cargo screening system HI-SCAN 145180-2is pro meets the demand for fast
turnaround, high levels of security and an attractive total cost of ownership (TCO).
[See product][148]
[
][149]
HCVG
The HCVG provides side view images of inspected vehicles, offering material discrimination for easy
assessment of cargo and vehicle contents in a single scan.
[See product][150]
[
][151]
SDX 6040
Designed for the many and varied operations requiring fast, effective screening of personal
belongings and small parcels.
[See product][152]
[
][153]
HCVP
An automatic, drive through scanner portal for the inspection of vehicles and containers,
guaranteeing constant vehicle flow on site.
[See product][154]
[
][155]
HI-SCAN 7555 DV
An advanced dual view X-ray screening system for automatic explosives detection at Airports, Urban
Security and Ports & Borders Checkpoints.
[See product][156]
[
][157]
BioFlash Biological Identifier
The biothreat detector provides rapid, biological aerosol collection and identification in a compact
unit.
[See product][158]
[
][159]
HCVT
The HCVT delivers side-view X-ray images of freight wagons or railcars.
[See product][160]
[
][161]
incent.view
incent.view workstations allow the review and analysis of X-ray images from all Smiths Detection
HiTraX based X-ray systems.
[See product][162]

][163]
DaiSy
Included in all Smiths Detection HCV systems, DaiSy gives operators access to customizable image
treatments and comparison tools, for the rapid interpretation of images and verification of cargo.
[See product][164]

iLane.evo
Delivering a steady flow of trays, the automatic tray return system iLane.evo plays a critical role
in streamlining the screening process and delivering the subsequent benefits of increased
throughput; optimized operational

[Sunlite Systems Pvt Ltd][148], headquartered in Ghaziabad, was founded in 2012 to close a real gap
in the Indian market — businesses needed one dependable source for genuine, warranty-backed IT and
AV equipment instead of juggling a dozen scattered vendors. That single idea has since grown into a
PAN-India supply operation trusted by corporates, institutions and government buyers alike.

Directors Mr. Shainki Bansal (Rohit) and Mr. Jatin Goyal lead a catalogue built around what
businesses actually deploy day to day: [Samsung Interactive Flat Panels][149], [All-in-One
PCs][150], projectors, [ALR projector screens][151], [teleprompters][152], video & audio
conferencing systems, commercial LFD displays, video walls, digital signage, CCTV and 4K PTZ
surveillance cameras, networking gear and enterprise storage — sourced straight from authorized
brand channels, never grey-market.

A 15-strong in-house team, carrying a combined 20+ years in the IT/AV trade, handles everything from
pre-sales consulting to installation — which is why we've become a go-to wholesale and channel
partner for [Samsung Interactive Flat Panels][153], [All-in-One PCs][154], [projector screens][155]
and [teleprompters][156], alongside networking, storage and CCTV surveillance deployments for
offices, schools and public-sector projects nationwide.

The Crowley Company is a unique blend of scanner manufacturer, scan system distributor and
digitization services bureau. This combination allows Crowley to understand the complexities of
archival preservation, records management and other imaging industry challenges from every angle,
providing a competitive and technological edge that cannot be found elsewhere.

We strive to offer the best digitization services, and only The Crowley Company can offer a complete
range of digital scanning solutions…

Trivitron delivers integrated, adaptable technology that strengthens healthcare from remote
communities to advanced hospitals — giving every clinician the tools for faster, more confident
decisions worldwide.

Early Detection at Population Scale. Scalable screening to detect disease early and protect
communities. From newborn screening to outbreak diagnostics, we empower national programs with
portable, cost-effective systems saving lives in resource-limited settings.

### Modern Laboratory Solutions

Precision Diagnostics, Accelerated Workflows. High-throughput diagnostic systems built for accuracy,
speed, and seamless automation. From routine to specialized tests, our advanced IVD platforms and
complete range of healthcare solutions deliver fast, reliable results that drive better clinical
decisions - globally.

### Hospitals and Clinics

Seamless technology for frontline care. Integrated medical technology solutions for confident,
real-time care. From patient monitors and ventilators to point-of-care devices, our modular systems
integrate effortlessly across rural clinics and tertiary hospitals.

### AI Solutions

AI That Works in the Real World. Practical AI for faster, more accurate diagnostics and smarter
workflows. From radiology image enhancement to predictive lab analytics, our clinically validated
tools integrate seamlessly into daily practice.
